<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/placement-rules"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every PlacementRule, ordered by rule id, each with a human-readable description of what it constrains. This is the full rule set a slot registration is evaluated against. Keyset-paginated: `limit` and `cursor`; follow `nextCursor` until it is absent.
